why: The Washington County moratorium (ORD-2026-12) is in effect as of 2026-10-26 and applies countywide, deferring all data center applications for a computed period of six months from 2026-06-30 to 2026-12-29 per the draft ordinance quote. The moratorium applies to the site per the finding's reason that it is in effect and the site is within its scope. The project's 300 MW load assumes 121 diesel generators (2,500 kW each) yielding an estimated NOx potential to emit of 1,067 tpy, exceeding the 100 tpy major-source threshold under 40 CFR 70.2 and triggering a Title V operating permit requirement. Because the county moratorium currently blocks all data center applications and a major federal air permit would be required, the project cannot proceed at this time.
